task.title: Independent final tool-call and model-round budget review (M10)
task.description: Independent Stage 1 review of the M10 budget corrections after T19. Verify against current code with bounded deterministic in-memory providers only: (1) maxRounds is an inclusive hard ceiling on every provider.stream() request within one runAgentTurn call, including any wrap-up; (2) maxRounds=0 issues no provider request and stops with the round-budget reason; (3) a text-only completion within the final allowed round is a clean completion; a tool-bearing final round executes only that response's tools then stops with finishReason budget and no further request; (4) interactive reset raises the ceiling before the next request, cancel stops locally with no wrap-up; (5) maxToolCalls counts actual successful tool invocations across batches, is independent from maxRounds, and yields finishReason tool-call-budget; (6) the spawn_subagent child maps max_tool_calls and max_rounds to distinct limits, its reservation/prompt text is truthful, and a strict round stop maps to BudgetExhausted; (7) benchmark/stress scripts terminate finitely with typed errors and the stress report uses the existing resolver. Re-run the two preserved probes (T16-child-budget-probe.ts, T16-recheck-round-budget-probe.ts) and the focused tests; write your own additional probe if a case is uncovered. Stage 2 (code quality) only after Stage 1 passes. Write T16-final-review.md and T16-final-result.json.
